Messages.Author: Judith Cookson Grunberger
Messages.Body:
Looking at Scott Johnson's RT rulings, I saw this:

Cloak the Gathering:
Its superior ability can be used to aid another minion even while the
modifying vampire is tapped.
Multiple vampires can use its superior version during a single action.

Is this very very very official? I always believed that superior Cloak
could not be used if the using minion was tapped.

This is why I'm asking: I'm in sort of an argument right now, and I need
to know. Furthermore, the other guy won't believe me unless I can point
to a *printed* source (ie, Duelist) because he doesn't trust 'net sources.

So. Does anyone have any info on this ruling, and in which Duelist it was
published?

Judy

The ruling appeared verbatim in article <39rdts$s...@perv.hal.COM>
"NEW: Rulings summary for Jyhad" posted on 9 Nov 1994 13:11:24 -0800
to rec.games.deckmaster.

It stems from the fact that you needn't be untapped to play an action
modifier, as you do to play a reaction (card text excepted, of course)
